title: Operational record access and publication
description: Typed current queries, task preview/execution and explicit store maintenance with coherent outcomes; CLI syntax and rendering remain outside storage ownership.

operations.name: inspect_records
operations.purpose: Read a selected coherent snapshot and its bounded observations.
inputs: Typed QueryRequest with associated project root, selected Change/item and explicit optional selectors. The caller need not already know the observed revision.
outputs: ReadOutcome with coherent selected values, contract and revision, observations, limitations and absent/unavailable/busy outcomes.
behavior: Open an existing associated SQLite store; never initialize or migrate as a read.
Allow only internal storage recovery of its already determined transaction outcome; never select an engineering effect or replay a task.
Return one coherent snapshot with explicit selected scope and missing/omitted distinctions.
Compare only requested supported subjects and label reported/compared/unknown basis honestly; completed accounts remain historical.
Expose actionable reliance gaps without authoring approval, activity or next action.

failure_behavior.condition: Input or selected records are unsupported, unavailable, unsafe, or incoherent.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return the applicable diagnostic and bounded observations without mutation, automatic migration, or application-level recovery selection.

operations.name: backup_operational_scope
operations.purpose: Capture a coherent selected v4 operational scope and its required payloads.
inputs: Explicit Change selection, absent backup destination and actor.
Use MaintenanceRequest and MaintenanceOutcome from the typed v4 boundary. The CLI supplies normalized task values and expectations, never SQL or a connection handle.
preconditions: This operation belongs to store-maintenance-v1; qualified source import does not establish legacy runtime dispatch.
outputs: Actual captured or activated scope, store/backup identity, retained-prior location and truthful outcome; or explicit conflict, busy, unavailable or incomplete maintenance facts.
behavior: Acquire maintenance exclusion after draining ordinary access leases. Capture a database snapshot, retain the selected Change closure and copy its required attachments.
Validate project/schema, references and backup-specific integrity; publish a complete marker only after all selected members are durable. Partial output never becomes a complete backup.

failure_behavior.condition: Interruption, invalid source, unavailable required payload or changed destination prevents a verified result.
failure_behavior.outcome: Preserve source/unrelated work and explicit incomplete or fenced recovery state. Do not replay decisions, silently initialize an empty recovered store or undo established activation to repair output delivery.

operations.name: restore_operational_scope
operations.purpose: Activate a validated selected backup with explicit destination authority.
inputs: Complete backup identity, expected destination observation, explicit replacement intent, actor and reason; or an exact maintenance-resume request.
Use MaintenanceRequest and MaintenanceOutcome from the typed v4 boundary. The CLI supplies normalized task values and expectations, never SQL or a connection handle.
preconditions: This operation belongs to store-maintenance-v1; qualified source import does not establish legacy runtime dispatch.
outputs: Actual captured or activated scope, store/backup identity, retained-prior location and truthful outcome; or explicit conflict, busy, unavailable or incomplete maintenance facts.
behavior: Validate the staged backup and association before changing live state; recheck expected destination under maintenance exclusion. No implicit merge or refreshed engineering approval.

Retain before/candidate identities and prior operational bytes; keep access fenced through path replacement, validation and a durable activated marker. Before activation allow only verified finish/rollback; after activation permit finish but no rollback.

For transfer, compose the selected backup with restoration only into a matching empty operational destination; expose exclusions, preserve the source and reject occupied/conflicting history. Project association is prepared explicitly outside maintenance and is never rewritten by this operation.

failure_behavior.condition: Interruption, invalid source, unavailable required payload or changed destination prevents a verified result.
failure_behavior.outcome: Preserve source/unrelated work and explicit incomplete or fenced recovery state. Do not replay decisions, silently initialize an empty recovered store or undo established activation to repair output delivery.

operations.name: migrate_operational_scope
operations.purpose: Stage a supported schema upgrade or dispositioned legacy import.
inputs: Selected supported migration mode, exact source/destination expectations, required backup/original retention destinations and attributable dispositions; or an exact maintenance-resume request.
Use MaintenanceRequest and MaintenanceOutcome from the typed v4 boundary. The CLI supplies normalized task values and expectations, never SQL or a connection handle.
preconditions: This operation belongs to store-maintenance-v1; qualified source import does not establish legacy runtime dispatch.
outputs: Actual captured or activated scope, store/backup identity, retained-prior location and truthful outcome; or explicit conflict, busy, unavailable or incomplete maintenance facts.
behavior: Schema upgrade creates its complete pre-upgrade backup and applies packaged ordered migrations to a staged candidate. Legacy import requires an absent destination, supported field mapping and explicit disposition of every selected source record.

Preserve required originals, unresolved obligations and original judgment meaning. Unknown formats, stale observations, unresolved dependencies or changed semantics block activation; activate through the same fenced replacement boundary as restore.

Maintain attributable source-writer quiescence through capture, final recheck and activation; the destination fence cannot supply it for legacy writers. Verify recoverable originals and reconcile every current consumer before activating one authoritative target; unresolved active dependencies or lost source control block continuation.

operations.name: preview_record_task
operations.purpose: Preview one typed v4 engineering task without reserving execution.
inputs: The closed TaskRequest and fixed receipt profile owned by the MOD-011 typed boundary; substantive values follow the selected MOD-010 task schema.
preconditions: Selected contract is rigorloop-records-v4. No v3 runtime fallback or semantic task replay.
outputs: Typed MutationOutcome with the established revision, bounded changed-record summary, diagnostics and truthful committed disposition.
behavior: Read a coherent current snapshot, check the expected revision and validate the complete proposed current state using the same task rules as execution.
Return a bounded prospective effect summary with committed=false. Publish no records or retained attachment bytes; preview does not supply an executable candidate, approval or reservation.

failure_behavior.condition: Input, expected revision, support, writer admission or commit cannot be established.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return the precise typed failure category and actual effect disposition. Do not invent a revision, silently merge stale intent or report an unknown commit as rejected with no effects.

operations.name: execute_record_task
operations.purpose: Execute one typed v4 task and return its actual storage outcome.
inputs: The closed TaskRequest and fixed receipt profile owned by the MOD-011 typed boundary; substantive values follow the selected MOD-010 task schema.
preconditions: Selected contract is rigorloop-records-v4. No v3 runtime fallback or semantic task replay.
outputs: Typed MutationOutcome with the established revision, bounded changed-record summary, diagnostics and truthful committed disposition.
behavior: Take the closed TaskRequest; acquire admission and writer exclusion, compare the opaque Change revision and reconstruct all related effects against that snapshot. No caller-supplied record bytes, SQL or construction callback are admitted.

Validate the complete candidate, preserve omitted obligations, update support standing and coordinate selected attachments under MOD-011 ownership. Recheck declared compared external subjects before commitment. Establish the selected receipt profile, including a bounded final-basis observation reserve, through the shared pure MOD-010-owned codec without exposing candidate or database capabilities.

Commit related records and their revisions atomically or abort the whole transaction before commitment. After confirmed commit, re-observe the same declared compared subjects against the original expectations before returning the typed outcome. Detected drift or an unestablished final comparison retains saved, committed=true and the actual committed revision with a bounded source-conflict observation requiring current inspection and applicability reassessment; no rollback, replay, expectation refresh or automatic judgment update occurs. A confirmed commit survives output failure; uncertain effects remain unknown and require a current read before reconciliation.

failure_behavior.condition: Input, expected revision, support, writer admission or commit cannot be established.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return the precise typed failure category and actual effect disposition. Do not invent a revision, silently merge stale intent or report an unknown commit as rejected with no effects.

operations.name: select_subject_history
operations.purpose: Select a coherent bounded retained history for an explicit recorded subject.
inputs: Explicit associated project, finite retained Change scope, recorded subject key or exact original basis, literal supported filters, page bound and optional state-bound continuation.
preconditions: The separately proposed history profile and complete cooperating writer/maintenance population are qualified; current v2/v4 support does not imply this capability.
outputs: Bounded complete result units with originating Change/record/subject identities, normalized selection, captured history state, coverage limits, exhaustion and optional continuation; or explicit invalid, conflict, busy, unavailable or too-large outcome.
behavior: Apply MOD-011 history-selection.md: MOD-010 owns admission/public presentation; MOD-011 owns recorded associations, coherent read snapshot, ordering and authenticated continuation.
Preserve original facts and partial/unavailable scope; no semantic relevance, current approval inference, implicit history reconstruction or mutation.
Keep the separate proposed operation distinct from current ordinary query grammar, schema and no-cursor result semantics.

MOD-010 performs structural and independently known request checks only; MOD-011 authenticates the opaque continuation and checks bound selection and captured state before any page results, retaining its key and state authority.

failure_behavior.condition: Association/retention coverage is missing, source/profile is unavailable, or selected scope is unreadable.
failure_behavior.outcome: Expose the actual missing or incomplete scope; do not present an empty complete history or initialize, recover or migrate storage.

failure_behavior.condition: Continuation identity/state/selection fails or bounded complete output cannot be formed.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return the specified bounded rejection without silent restart, partial conflicting page, omitted narrative or cursor advance past an unreturned unit.

Preserve the owning public contract's null, omission, absent-store, and error distinctions when that basis is unavailable; never invent an identity. Established identity, revision, assessment subject, and diagnostic observation identity remain distinct.
The successor supports the current v2/v4 typed boundary only. Prior file-journal interface clauses are recoverable at 39be9c81 and do not supply a parallel operational path.
The caller supplies substantive decisions. Mechanical validity and a successful save grant no approval, progression, or satisfaction.

MOD-010 owns public envelopes, rendering and selection; MOD-011 supplies coherent state and actual effect facts and enforces the prepublication safety boundary. Public receipt readiness must cover that same candidate without giving either Module authority over engineering decisions.

The MOD-011 typed-boundary section owns target request variants and storage facts; MOD-010 owns public projection, encoding, primary diagnostic codes and exits. Fixed receipt profiles preserve precommit readiness without accepting arbitrary caller callbacks. Exact-file candidate operations and their associated recovery are v3-only, not aliases for the v4 tasks.
